closeout.summary: Closed the managed SKU compatibility repair: valid identity-bearing managed state is preserved; legacy, identity-less, or malformed managed state returns to setup-required; malformed confirmation input is rejected. Delivered by Commerce PR #9 at source fc14de74bb217e8803c9441cdb27797c778b820a and merge 7b09a25749ce2c650f294a0bd5ab7d99132d2ce5. The next recommended grill is retry-safe Commerce-to-Inventory registration orchestration.

current_focus.summary: Repair Commerce PR #9 by preserving valid identity-bearing stock states, returning identity-less or malformed managed persisted states as setup-required, and rejecting malformed needs-review confirmation input. Verify legacy replay, valid replay, malformed confirmation, full repository contracts, runtime behavior, and exact-head independent review. No live Inventory mutation, deployment, or merge is included.

decisions.choice: On read, preserve valid identity-bearing managed states; downgrade legacy or malformed managed states that cannot satisfy the contract to setup-required, requiring explicit fresh registration. Independently reject malformed needs-review candidates before activation.

decisions.question: How should persisted managed state that cannot satisfy the identity-bearing Inventory SKU contract behave?
decisions.rationale: This is the fail-safe pre-release upgrade path recommended by exact-head review: Commerce never invents an Inventory identity, never leaves an invalid active state, and never silently activates malformed persisted input.

alternatives: Use a new commandId for each retry, accepting that an ambiguous timeout may return existing and require unnecessary user confirmation.
recommendation.reason: A stable hidden retry identity preserves idempotency across network uncertainty without changing the customer-visible SKU or Inventory SKU identity.
recommendation.recommended: Make Commerce registration retries reuse one durable operation ID as the Inventory commandId so a timed-out successful registration remains the same request.
